retrievalProfile.description: A minimalist high-key studio portrait featuring a subject seated in profile against a vast neutral background with vertically stacked condensed typography in the upper right quadrant.
triggerTerms: high-key studio portrait with condensed type
excludeWhen: busy or textured backgrounds are required
vibrant neon color palettes are needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A clean, high-key studio photograph of a man seated on a wicker chair, positioned on the left side of the frame, looking toward the viewer. The right two-thirds of the image is dominated by a soft, off-white negative space containing two levels of typography: a large, ultra-condensed sans-serif name and a smaller, italicized subtitle.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject anchored to the left edge against expansive right-side negative space
High contrast between dark clothing and light background
Vertical alignment of text blocks in the upper right corner
Soft, diffused lighting creating minimal shadows on the backdrop
coreInvariants: Asymmetrical balance with subject on the left

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is seated, occupying the left third of the frame, scaled to show from the head to the mid-thigh.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's dark torso provides the primary visual weight, balanced by the text block in the upper right.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The viewer's eye starts at the subject's face, follows the line of the body down to the chair, then moves across the negative space to the typography.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive off-white negative space occupies the center and right portions of the frame.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm Tan (Wicker chair and skin tones)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the subject and the background.

letterConstructionRules: Extremely high aspect ratio (tall and narrow)
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High contrast between a massive, condensed sans-serif and a small, delicate italic serif.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the ultra-condensed, flat-terminal look of the display text.
Provides the necessary verticality and clean sans-serif structure.
Provides a classic, sophisticated contrast for the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A high-key studio portrait of a man in a black shirt and white trousers seated on a wicker chair, positioned on the left side of a clean, off-white background with soft lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add ultra-condensed sans-serif uppercase text in the upper right corner, stacked vertically, in a medium grey color. Below it, add a small line of italicized serif text in the same color.

verificationChecks: Is the subject positioned on the left third of the frame?
Is the display text ultra-condensed and stacked?
Is the background a clean, high-key neutral tone?
Is the subtitle italicized and significantly smaller than the main text?

mustRedesign: Exact wording of the original title
postGenerationChecks: Ensure text does not overlap the subject
Check that the display font is sufficiently condensed
Verify the high-key lighting is consistent across the frame
Confirm the asymmetrical balance feels intentional
recipe.reuseFormula: Seated subject on left + high-key neutral space on right + stacked ultra-condensed type in upper right = Sophisticated Soul Aesthetic.
